title: Ultimate Music Pack
description: Provides the directory to easily change the music for Ultimate Battle & Location Music!
body:
**This resource pack allows you to easily change the music for these mods:**

# **[🔴 MOD REQUIRED: Ultimate Battle Music](https://modrinth.com/mod/ultimate_battle_music)**
# **[🔵 MOD REQUIRED: Ultimate Location Music](https://modrinth.com/mod/ultimate_location_music)**

**Simply download the Resource Pack, extract the zip inside your resourcepacks folder, and swap the music files!**
****
**This Resource Pack provides the directories ready-to-use with the default music.**

**The path for each file is as follows:**

## 🔴 assets\ultimate_battle_music\sounds
**1. Bosses:**  
**battle_enderdragon.ogg | battle_wither.ogg | battle_warden.ogg**  
**2. Raid:**  
**battle_raid.ogg**  
**3. Illager:**  
**battle_illager.ogg**  
**4. Nether:**  
**battle_nether.ogg**  
**5. Normal & Variant:**  
**battle_music.ogg | battle_variant.ogg**
****
## 🔵 assets\ultimate_location_music\sounds
- **location_1.ogg**  
- **location_2.ogg**  
- **etc.**  

**_Note: you can add up to 32 songs in that same fashion!_**

****
